verdict.rationale: Moss has dedicated first-party integration pages for LangChain, covering RAG pipelines and agentic workflows, and for the Vercel AI SDK, which exposes Moss operations as agent tools. Its docs also list LiveKit and Pipecat connectors, so the core of plugging Moss into agent frameworks is clearly documented. Missing for 10: any evidence of a LlamaIndex integration, evidence that the integrations are actively maintained (versioned packages or release history), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
